newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank cuts Dresdner to neutral vs buy.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank cuts Dresdner to neutral vs buy.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank said on Thursday it had lowered its recommendation for Dresdner Bank AG shares to neutral from buy as the shares were fairly rated at current values.
Bank analyst Nathalie Grasegger said in a statement that Vereinsbank did not expect Dresdner's shares to outperform the DAX index of 30 leading shares in the next six months.
The shares have risen strongly in recent weeks and have outperformed rivals Deutsche Bank AG and Commerzbank AG since August.
Dresdner's price-earnings ratio of 13.8 based on estimated 1997 earnings was already in line with the sector's average of 14.0, Grasegger said.

"Within the sector we still see the bank as having a solid earnings structure good earnings development and strong substance but we do not expect the share at this level to outperform the DAX over the next six months," the statement said.
Dresdner shares closed at 45.20 marks on Thursday, down 0.35 marks.
